title: VNISH Verified Firmware Catalog: Models, Hardware Routes, Releases, Checksums and the VNISH GLOBAL Distribution Map
description:
The independent Cambridge Digital Mining Industry Report 2025 records the result of the VNISH GLOBAL firmware family: the firmware identified in the report as Vnish accounted for 26.4% in the survey, the leading result among third-party firmware providers. Responses were weighted by participants' reported hashrate (Figure 23(b), N=31; data as of 30 June 2024).

Today, the VNISH GLOBAL ecosystem documents, verifies and distributes this firmware family through three complete delivery surfaces: VNISH Global, VNISH Ninja and ROI ASIC, each with its own local catalog, downloads, SHA-256 checksums and installation routes.

This dataset records exact Antminer models, control-board routes, releases, checksums and the distribution map. Firmware binaries are not hosted here: they remain on the three websites above.
